title: US-short §8 ship-gate sizing governance — const-pins live_permission_status vocab + the maturity-is-reminder-not-cap / ungraduated-not-full-size / real-money-manual / hard-veto-zero-position safety rules
description: Batch-1 declarative governance contract. Freezes the §8 ship-gate sizing posture: model_position_size_* and live_size_warning are emitted on the NORMAL sizing basis (maturity is a REMINDER, not a formula cap — 成熟度 = 提醒、不是算式帽); live_permission_status vocab {paper_or_minimal_only, not_full_size_eligible, full_size_eligible} (== action_table); an un-graduated track is NEVER a real-money full-size license (未毕业不得当真金满仓许可) and the real-money amount is set manually; and hard veto = 0 position (line 234). Graduation thresholds / maturity reminder levels are forward priors routed to §13.1 #12, not pinned. draft-07 cannot express: vocab byte-faithfulness + == action_table, fields ⊆ action_table columns, provenance in §8, and calibration_item_id ∈ the lifecycle registry — enforced in tests.

maturity_is_reminder_not_cap.description: §8 成熟度 = 提醒、不是算式帽 — sizing is emitted on the normal basis; maturity does not cap the formula.

ungraduated_not_full_size_license.description: §8 未毕业不得当真金满仓许可 — an un-graduated track is never a real-money full-size license.

real_money_amount_manual.description: §8 真金投多少手动定 — the real-money amount is set manually, not auto-sized to full.

hard_veto_zero_position.description: §8 (line 234) hard veto = 0 仓 — a hard veto forces zero position.

calibration_item_id.description: §8 graduation thresholds + live_permission_status / maturity reminder levels = prior → §13.1 #12.
